note: Authored from docs/spec; expected facts are derived by tools/fixtures/movement, not by packages/core. No state or draw hashes: later entries assert those.
tick: 60 Hz fixed; phases input, waits, threads, events, movement, edges, triggers, animation, audio, time (AD-26); random encounters hand off from triggers.
units: board pixels; fractions are exact multiples of 1/256

cases.name: stationary-loses
cases.note: R-51 item 2: a stationary sprite loses to a moving one and freezes for 120 ticks; the winner is blocked for that tick only.

cases.name: freeze-thaw-and-refreeze
cases.note: The frozen sprite thaws after exactly 120 ticks and, still stationary, loses again at the next test.

cases.name: controlled-player-wins-between-movers
cases.note: Both moving: the user-controlled player wins.

cases.name: faster-sprite-wins
cases.note: Neither controlled, both moving: the smaller ticksPerAdvance wins.

cases.name: equal-speed-larger-drawid-loses
cases.note: Total order (AD-25): equal speeds, the sprite with the larger drawId loses.

cases.name: diversion-around-blocker
cases.note: R-51 item 3: a path-following item blocked by a sprite makes one local diversion (cap 1000, active mode) and the collision is not applied.

cases.name: no-route-waits-then-continues
cases.note: R-51 item 4: with no route the actor waits, retesting each tick; when the blocker clears (tick 40) it continues, with no freeze.

cases.name: no-route-wait-expires-and-stops
cases.note: R-51 item 4: after 120 ticks of waiting the actor stops, its queue clears and the direct result applies (the larger drawId, the walker, freezes).
